heroHeadline: Adidas x Bad Bunny Ballerina 'Flamboyan' Drops Today at All The Right NYC — European Stadium Leg Opens Barcelona in 7 Days
heroSubtitle: The Bad Bunny x Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (Vivid Red, KI7916, $120) launched today at All The Right boutique in New York City — the exclusive early drop two weeks ahead of the May 30 wide release on Adidas Confirmed. Named after Puerto Rico's iconic flamboyán tree (spelled in Puerto Rican vernacular), the shoe features a gold 'Benito' embossing, maroon lace toggle, and 'Adidas Para Bad Bunny' midsole stamp. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour European stadium leg opens in seven days — May 22–23 at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (sold out), Bad Bunny's first European stadium shows in six years — before continuing to Lisbon, Madrid (10 shows at Riyadh Air Metropolitano — the most shows by any act at a single venue on one tour in Spanish history), Düsseldorf, Arnhem, London, Paris, Stockholm, Warsaw, Milan, and Brussels through July 22. Director Residente's May 14 Deadline interview confirmed *Porto Rico* principal photography is expected to begin late 2026 in Puerto Rico, with Bad Bunny leading as 19th-century revolutionary José Maldonado Román alongside Viggo Mortensen, Edward Norton, and Javier Bardem, executive produced by Alejandro González Iñárritu. 'DtMF' stands at 58+ consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs — the all-time chart record.
